displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-024: AI — Model Performance Degradation Alert
description:
Detects significant AI model performance degradation that requires governance review

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_024", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%model%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%performance%') AND "value" > 0
